assetProfile.longBusinessSummary: Meta Platforms, Inc. engages in the development of products that enable people to connect and share with friends and family through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and internationally. QUALCOMM Incorporated was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.
